name: Recorded-availability-controlled new-order task
population: MIMIC-IV 3.1 admissions linked to the existing MIMIC-IV-ED cohort; full hospital source tables are re-read
followup: Hospital discharge must be at or after the end of the prediction window
potential_target: A prescription row whose linked provider ordertime OR pharmacy entertime falls in the window
trusted_target: Exact patient/admission joins on both paths; provider ordertime AND pharmacy entertime in the window; pharmacy verifiedtime non-null and no later than the window end; transaction New or Change
coherent_case_rule: Exclude an admission if any potential target lacks the trusted timestamp/identity/type criteria. Require at least one trusted target. This is a selected, order-triggered retrospective cohort, not all hospital admissions.

inputs.demographics: Recorded gender and decade-binned approximate age at admission; no patient IDs
inputs.prior_orders: Same admission, exact joins, provider ordertime, pharmacy entertime and verifiedtime all before decision; all three must be non-null; maximum of them in the preceding 24 hours; retain at most 24 most recently available distinct drug/route/dose/unit/frequency tuples
inputs.labs: Same admission blood labs, both charttime and storetime no later than decision, charttime in previous 24 hours, numeric value; latest per itemid; at most 32 most recently stored measurements

split: Preserve original patient train/validation/test assignments; split validation patients into proposal/guard; exclude all v0.6, v0.7 and v0.9 test patients from the new test
sampling: Deterministic case hashes with the v21 salt; use all eligible cases if below the cap and report actual sizes
drug_space: Raw normalized drug names; vocabulary learned from initial training cases only; all gold drugs remain in recall denominators
unknown_fields: Remain unknown and are not fabricated; no saline-presence F1
limitations: Availability is recorded-source availability, not proof of clinician viewing
The released tables are not a full version history
Coherent-time and nonempty-target selection limits generalization
Historical order agreement is not clinical safety
privacy: All patient rows, features, labels, predictions and models remain local under the restricted directory; no API calls
